training_audiences.title: Affiliation Reviewer Training Audience
training_audiences.content: The knowledge reviewers require to operate governed affiliation decisions.
training_audiences.delivery: The delivery method by which that content would be provided.
training_audiences.competence: The demonstrable competence a reviewer must hold, distinct from mere content exposure.
training_audiences.onboarding: The onboarding path for a new reviewer, distinct from sustained adoption.
training_audiences.sustained_adoption: The sustained adoption expected of reviewers over time.
training_audiences.accessibility: All training must meet accessibility obligations.
training_audiences.bilingual: All training must be available bilingually.

adoption_measures.title: Reviewer Sustained Adoption Measure
adoption_measures.sustained_adoption: Sustained adoption is defined as continued governed use with demonstrated competence, distinct from initial onboarding.
